subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest set a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536` default, or should this remain optional operator guidance?
rationale: This is an operator-facing runtime default rather than a pure docs note, and repository policy treats config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive even when they mitigate a real deployment problem.

options.title: Ship a corrected fixed cap
options.body: Accept the manifest env default after the contributor corrects the Node/cgroup wording and adds redacted Kubernetes proof for the reported OOM path.

options.title: Make it docs-only guidance
options.body: Drop the manifest default and document how Kubernetes operators can set `NODE_OPTIONS` when their workload needs additional headroom.

options.title: Pause until stronger evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it later if no runtime proof appears for the reported Kubernetes OOM behavior.

recommendation.title: Ship a corrected fixed cap
recommendation.body: Accept the manifest env default after the contributor corrects the Node/cgroup wording and adds redacted Kubernetes proof for the reported OOM path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main touches plus the repo-level default-surface decision make this the best available routing candidate from the observed history.
